result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.has_edge_id()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Check if an edge with given ID exists. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3615-L3652){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.has_edge_id(edge_id) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Verifies whether a specific edge ID is present in the graph. Useful for validating edge IDs before performing operations. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [edge_id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The edge ID to check. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `True` if an edge with this ID exists, `False` otherwise. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Check if edge IDs exist: ::: {#e0af142a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") ) edge_id = graph.get_edge_ids()[0] graph.has_edge_id(edge_id=edge_id) # Returns True graph.has_edge_id(edge_id=9999) # Returns False ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` False ``` ::: :::
